### Repro steps

Chrome extension error prevents React components from rendering: Cannot add child "1179" to parent "1102"

Description

While testing my React application, one page suddenly stopped rendering. Instead of showing the React components, the browser console displayed an error originating from a Chrome extension.

Console Error:

Uncaught Error: Cannot add child "1179" to parent "1102"

The error was thrown at:
chrome-extension://fmkadmapgofadopljbjfkapdkoienihi/build/main.js:1:725729
    at p.emit (chrome-extension://fmkadmapgofadopljbjfkapdkoienihi/build/main.js:1:680330)
    at chrome-extension://fmkadmapgofadopljbjfkapdkoienihi/build/main.js:1:682241
    at bridgeListener (chrome-extension://fmkadmapgofadopljbjfkapdkoienihi/build/main.js:1:1189368)
Expected Behavior

The page should render normally and display all React components.

Actual Behavior

The page fails to render, and the console shows the error above.

Environment
React: (your version)
Browser: Google Chrome
OS: Ubuntu
Build Tool: Vite
Additional Information

The error originates from a chrome-extension:// URL rather than my application's source code. Disabling the extension allows the page to render normally.

I'm trying to understand:

Is this a known compatibility issue with React DevTools or another Chrome extension?
Has anyone encountered this error before?
Is there any workaround besides disabling the extension?

### How often does this bug happen?

Sometimes
